environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed in VPC (subnet-0a3f8c, subnet-0b7d2e) with a Gateway VPC Endpoint for S3 (vpce-0x8a3b9f2c1d4e5678) attached to route tables rtb-0fa82c and rtb-0eb91d. The VPC endpoint has a custom policy document that uses a Condition block with StringEquals on 's3:prefix' and a StringLike on 'aws:ResourceAccount' matching only the owning account ID (112233445566). Additionally, the endpoint policy restricts s3:CopyObject and s3:PutObject actions to only buckets matching 'arn:aws:s3:::company-*-prod' and 'arn:aws:s3:::company-*-prod/*'. The VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached, so all S3 API calls MUST traverse the VPC endpoint. Security group sg-0f4a8b2c on the Lambda ENIs allows only outbound to prefix list pl-63a5400a (S3). No other egress path exists.
